A multi-target Pierce E.G.O with Minus Coins that uses Charge built from Envy Resonance and Tails Hits to raise its power.
messages.充電による威力強化: 充電5を消耗するたびにスキル威力+3(解析Ⅳ、最大+12): **Power from Charge**: +3 Skill Power for every 5 Charge spent (Threadspin Ⅳ, up to +12). Its Coins are Minus Coins with −12 Coin Power, so power drops the more Heads land.
messages.充電の稼ぎ方: 使用時に嫉妬共鳴数だけ充電が増え(解析Ⅲ)、裏面的中時にも充電が: **Earning Charge**: Charge increases by Envy Resonance on use (Threadspin Ⅲ), and also on Tails Hit.
messages.パッシブ「咆哮」: 敵を倒すと、嫉妬完全共鳴数の半分だけ充電が増える。条件が厳し: **Passive — Roar**: Defeating an enemy increases Charge by half of Envy Absolute Resonance. A minor supplement with a strict condition and small effect.
messages.侵蝕スキル: 充電を全消費して威力が上がるが、表面的中のたびに次のターンの脆弱が: **Corrosion skill**: Spends all Charge to gain power, but each Heads Hit increases Fragile next turn. It attacks friend and foe alike.
messages.嫉妬の共鳴を作って充電を溜めてから撃つ。表裏で威力が大きくぶれるので、確実なマッ: Build Envy Resonance to store Charge before firing. Its power swings widely between Heads and Tails, so it is not suited to reliable Clashes.
messages.必要資源は憤怒3・色欲2・嫉妬3と重いので、編成で賄えるかが前提になる。: It requires a heavy 3 Wrath, 2 Lust, and 3 Envy, so whether the team can cover it is the premise.
messages.Ⅲ: 威力が上がり、使用時の充電獲得が加わり、裏面的中時の充電が3から5になる。: **Ⅲ**: Raises power, adds Charge gain on use, and raises Charge on Tails Hit from 3 to 5.
messages.Ⅳ: 充電を5消耗するたびに威力+3(最大+12)となり、強化の幅が大きく広がる: **Ⅳ**: Becomes +3 power for every 5 Charge spent (up to +12), greatly widening the enhancement range.
messages.マルチクラック事務所フィクサー: 充電を得るスキルがあり、S1(憤怒)とS2(嫉: **[MultiCrack Office Fixer](persona:0709)**: Has skills that gain Charge, and S1 (Wrath) and S2 (Envy) also supply this E.G.O's resources.
messages.南部シ協会5課: S1が色欲、S2が憤怒、S3が嫉妬で、必要資源の3種をすべてス: **[Shi Assoc. South Section 5](persona:0702)**: S1 is Lust, S2 is Wrath, and S3 is Envy, supplying all three required affinities through skills.
